body: WEIGHTED COVERAGE CANDIDATE — bd-01M17466HSR8A41TP6TSQ23WM4. CANDIDATE eaeb3da2a0f4d245b9abef1b0e6a047c57946aa0 on scout/weighted-coverage in /private/tmp/storymodel4s-wog-final2, based on current main 6dd3ca6; tree clean. Scope is exactly the six reserved files. Implements checked non-case WeightedCoverage carrying ScoreEstimate + exact conditioning weight + Coverage; zero observed -> AllMissing, observed zero total weight -> Undefined(ZeroTotalWeight), positive support -> Observed(numerator/weight). Invalid/nonfinite/negative inputs refuse. RecallSignature projection consumes the estimate and retains coverage support. Required same-eligible/same-weight/same-value discriminator distinguishes one-heavy from two-light only by observed coverage. External compile probes forbid apply/new/copy/Product/Mirror. Capacity-to-fail mutation class -> case class made the clean external boundary gate fail 1/7, then restored clean. Exact-SHA author gate in ordinary clone: compileAll green; align JVM/JS/Native 198 each; embedBench JVM 63; fixtures JVM 116; scalafmtCheckAll LAST exit 0. reference-scope independently names align, embed-bench, fixtures, matching the gate. No codec exists for RecallSignature; ADR 0003 amendment records that rather than inventing serialization. Requesting independent exact-SHA review before chief landing.
